title: Deduplicate preferred embedding provider attempts
goal: Keep a named embedding provider first without retrying it when the general provider list follows, preserving the bounded fallback cascade and its error behavior.

reuse.searched: Inspected the current embed_from provider cascade, CapabilityRegistry ordering, existing embed-budget tests, and the core/commercial split. The defect is in the existing core ordering logic; no third-party code or dependency is needed.
reuse.reason: Reuse the existing registry and provider contract; this is a one-loop correctness fix.

results.change: GemiEngine::embed_from now collects each registered provider once and stably moves the named provider to the front, instead of appending the preferred provider and retrying it in the general cascade.
results.focused: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-gemi --lib embed_budget: 3 passed, 0 failed; the new regression observed one preferred-provider call and successful fallback.
results.format: cargo fmt --all --check and git diff --check: passed.
results.ceilings: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test lean_core_ceilings: 2 passed, 0 failed; susi-gemi remains within its 20,709-line ceiling.
results.integration: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test host_only_privacy: 2 passed, 0 failed; isolated cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test peer_channel_hub: 2 passed, 0 failed.
results.native_check: cargo local-workflow check built and ran all 134 binaries; after the line-neutral fix, the only failure was the existing concurrent peer_channel_hub broken-pipe race. Its isolated rerun passed 2/2. No unrelated failure was masked.
